heroHeadline: A church for three generations, in three languages.
heroLede: We have gathered in Monterey Park for fifty years. Grandparents worship in Cantonese, parents in Mandarin, children in English — in the same building, on the same morning.

value.heading: Join us this Sunday
value.intro: Three congregations, one church. Everyone is welcome at any service.

value.heading: A look at our 50th anniversary
value.caption: Videos are embedded from YouTube, never stored on the website.

value.heading: Fifty years in Monterey Park
value.body: We began in 1976 with a handful of families. Today three congregations share this building, and many of our members are the children and grandchildren of the people who started it.

value.heading: More photos
value.body: We post photos from events to Facebook, where our members already are.
